description:
Every prompt (question Refora asks the AI models) in a workspace and how it performs, in one call: its text, topics, buyer-journey intent, whether it names the own brand, search volume, the own brand's visibility and its change, visibility per AI model, the leading tracked competitor, the brand AI names most, and a status: winning, competitive, losing (a competitor appears, the brand does not), untapped (no tracked brand appears) or no_answers. Also totals per status, per topic and per intent.

Use this tool to see the whole picture or find where to act -- phrases like 'which prompts are we losing', 'where are we weakest', 'list our prompts', 'which topics should we work on', 'what does Refora track for us'. Then drill into one prompt with get_prompt_performance or read its answers with get_ai_answers, passing its prompt_text.

Filter with status, model, topic, intent and branded; sort with sort_by. 25 prompts per page (limit up to 100), next_offset for more.

Example: 'Which of our prompts are we losing to competitors in ChatGPT?'

branded.description: Prompts that name the workspace's own brand (e.g. 'is Acme good?') inflate its numbers. 'exclude' leaves them out -- the dashboard's 'without brand queries' switch -- 'only' keeps just them. Default 'include', everything.
branded.title: Branded

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 365. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

intent.description: Optional: count only the prompts at this buyer-journey stage: PROBLEM_AWARENESS, SOLUTION_COMPARISON, COMPETITOR_COMPARISON, EVALUATION, CATEGORY_DEEP_DIVE or HOW_TO. Omit for every prompt.
intent.title: Intent

model.description: Optional: count only answers from these AI models. One model, or a list such as ["openai", "google-aio"]. openai = ChatGPT, anthropic = Claude, mistral = Le Chat, google-aio = Google AI Overviews. Omit for every model.
model.title: Model

offset.description: How many prompts to skip: the previous page's next_offset. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

sort_by.description: Order of the list. topic (default) groups by topic; visibility puts the brand's best prompts first, visibility_asc its weakest; competitor_lead puts the largest lead of a tracked competitor first; search_volume the most-searched first.
sort_by.title: Sort By

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

status.description: Optional: only prompts with this status. losing = a tracked competitor appears and the brand does not; competitive = both appear, the competitor more often; winning = the brand appears at least as often as any tracked competitor; untapped = no tracked brand appears. Omit for every prompt.
status.title: Status

topic.description: Optional: count only the prompts with this topic -- the workspace's own topic labels, as list_prompts and list_workspaces show them (e.g. 'läxhjälp'). Case does not matter. An unknown topic returns the topics that exist. Omit for every prompt.
topic.title: Topic

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: list_prompts
title: List prompts
